python << 'EOF'
import parse

print("=== R2: Digit field numbering tests ===")

tests = [
    # (format, text, expected_result)
    ('{0:d}', '42', (42,)),
    ('{0:d}', '-42', (-42,)),
    ('{0:d}', '+42', (42,)),
    ('{0:x}', 'ff', (255,)),
    ('{0:b}', '1010', (10,)),
    ('{0:o}', '77', (63,)),
    ('{0:f}', '3.14', (3.14,)),
    ('{0:.2f}', '3.14159', (3.14,)),
    ('{0:>10}', 'hello     ', ('hello     ',)),
    ('{0:<10}', '     hello', ('     hello',)),
    ('{0:^10}', '   hello  ', ('   hello  ',)),
]

for fmt, text, expected in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, text)
    if r is None:
        print(f"FAIL: parse('{fmt}', '{text}') = None (expected {expected})")
    else:
        result = r.fixed
        if result == expected:
            print(f"OK: parse('{fmt}', '{text}') = {r}")
        else:
            print(f"FAIL: parse('{fmt}', '{text}') = {r} (expected {expected})")
EOF
